title: Implement dashboard page (/)
description: Implement the main dashboard page showing overview stats and recent batches. Entry point for the admin app.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows summary stats: total batches, total prospects, prospects ready, prospects failed
Shows a list of recent batches with name, industry, date, prospect count, and a link to the batch detail
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Server component. Load stats via repository: `listBatches()`, count prospects by status. Render the dashboard UI.
Four shadcn/ui Cards showing: Total Batches, Total Prospects, Ready (status='ready'), Failed (status='failed'). Use large numbers with muted labels.
Table or card list of the 5 most recent batches. Columns: Name, Industry, Date Created, Prospect Count. Each row links to `/batches/{id}`.
Prominent 'New Batch' button at the top right linking to `/batches/new`.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify stats cards and recent batches list are visible.
